narrative.overview: The user's colorful Swapy reference supplies the visual world: flat pastel surfaces, emerald and yellow contrast, large figures, and variable card widths. This record applies only to the optional `?layout=cards` workspace and its calendar. The existing `studio/DESIGN.md` continues to describe the classic interface.
keyCharacteristics: Solid pastel cards with strong dark text.
Large readable metrics and bottom-aligned actions.
Explicit editing mode with equivalent pointer and keyboard movement.

rules.name: The Surface Color Rule
rules.body: Calendar colors repeat yellow, lilac, blue, pink by row order; they do not encode publication status. Status remains written text.

dos: Do preserve readable dark text on pastel cards and yellow text on the dark welcome/request cards.
Do retain explicit status and measurement-scope notes alongside prominent numbers.
Do retain keyboard movement, visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don’t use calendar color as the sole publication-status signal.
Don’t extend this optional card world into classic screens without a new scoped decision.
